dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, germinal-center B-cell type by Hans algorithm

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor stage IV, Lugano stage IV B, with bulky disease.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: plus FDG-avid right renal (3.2 cm), left adrenal (2.6 cm) and hepatic segment VI (1.8 cm) lesions

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present: drenching night sweats most nights and unintentional weight loss of about 11%

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: so not double-expressor by standard cut-offs; FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so there is no double-hit biology

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: so not double-expressor by standard cut-offs

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: Four points places him in the high-risk group
prog_cns_ipi_high.note: Counts CNS-IPI as 4 (omits ECOG and extranodal points; true score 6) but correctly classifies high risk including kidney/adrenal.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin, rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, prednisone) every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_pola_preferred.quote: NCCN lists pola-R-CHP as a preferred first-line regimen for DLBCL

mn_da_epoch.quote: Not indicated now: DA-EPOCH-R (no double-hit biology)

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: If ECOG is confirmed at 3 before cycle 1, I would switch to a dose-reduced regimen (R-mini-CHOP type) rather than full pola-R-CHP.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: and renal and/or adrenal involvement (1). Four points places him in the high-risk group

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: brain MRI with and without gadolinium (a group II agent is acceptable at eGFR 50) and lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: (c) Avoid high-dose methotrexate: eGFR 50, age, and the hydration needs of tumor lysis.
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Discusses prophylaxis with uncertain evidence and ties HD-MTX to renal function, but rejects HD-MTX outright and favors IT MTX rather than framing HD-MTX as an option after renal recovery.

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: avoid high-dose methotrexate given eGFR 50 and age

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Complete metabolic response (Deauville 1 to 3, no new lesions) means observation.
resp_eot_pet_lugano.note: Uses Deauville 5-point scale and CMR terminology but does not name Lugano.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Residual Deauville 4 to 5 at end of treatment: biopsy if clinically suspicious

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Recheck electrolytes and urate every 6 to 12 hours for the first 48 hours.
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: Hydration, rasburicase and q6-12h labs ordered, but only for 48 hours (workup section says daily through 72 hours).

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: If G6PD is normal, give rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg IV daily per protocol because urate is already elevated.

sup_gcsf.quote: Give primary G-CSF support (pegfilgrastim or on-body injector)

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: stop ibuprofen and all NSAIDs, including OTC products

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: arrange basal or NPH insulin with the prednisone schedule and glucose checks through the diabetes team

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg and anti-HBc nonreactive, anti-HBs reactive; no antiviral prophylaxis needed.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: This is acceptable for an anthracycline; repeat only with symptoms.

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: Assessment: fit for curative full-dose pola-R-CHP with supportive care
fit_ecog_disease_related.note: Gives full-dose curative therapy at ECOG 2 and notes goal of cure, but does not explicitly attribute ECOG 2 to the lymphoma.
